title: Typography
slide_intent: Mark a change of subject with a visible type voice so readers recognize that letterform choice is itself part of the identity.
strategic_value: The oversized rounded brown letters on orange can establish Flame as a recognizable Burger King ingredient before the rules begin.
demonstration: A single large uppercase TYPOGRAPHY heading occupies the upper portion of an orange divider.
practical_value: Use this divider to compare the brand’s display voice with the functional running labels.

content_islands.name: Display heading
content_islands.spec: Place the dark brown all-caps heading near the upper left on a full orange field.

content_islands.name: Document navigation
content_islands.spec: Keep small chapter labels across the top and the rights notice at bottom left.

reference_purposes.Expression: The orange field and large rounded Flame lettering demonstrate the display treatment.
